name: linear-devotee
description: Linear planning, recoverable project creation, and full issue delivery through native PR review, protected merge, and verified completion on Claude Code and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, create, and deliver Linear work
interface.longDescription: Linear Devotee briefs issues with decision sources, plans their assigned Acceptance, and reviews actual integration and observable verification. Full delivery reuses one issue workspace and PR through native review, corrections, protected merge, and observed Linear completion. Project creation replays the authorized payload, recovers by exact markers, and verifies the resulting graph. Existing authorization carries through scoped handoffs.
defaultPrompt: Use Linear Devotee to brief this Linear issue before implementation.
Use Linear Devotee to deliver this issue through PR review, merge, and Linear completion.
Use Linear Devotee to create a project, milestones, and issues from this spec.
Use Linear Devotee to recommend the next issue after this one is done.
